newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar ends near highs, activity dull.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar ends near highs, activity dull.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures closed near the day's highs, but trade remained light as many players waited on the sidelines for updates on Hurricane Lili, market sources said.

Hurricane Lili headed towards Cuba, packing winds of 75 mph (120 kph), the National Hurricane Center said. Cuba issued a hurricane warning for its western provinces. Forecasters said the warning could be extended to the eastern provinces, later today.
Cuba's sugar crop is two to three months from harvest.
Mexico said it exported 579,636 tonnes of sugar between January and October
Today's activity failed to lift the March contract over nearby resistance seen at 10.80. Support was seen at 10.60 in March.
March closed up 0.07 at 10.77, having ranged from 10.78 to 10.69. The back months finished 0.01 to 0.05 higher.
Volume was estimated at only 6,383 lots.

Libya said it will postpone the deadline for bids in its white sugar buying tender until Friday, instead of today. Libya tendered on Tuesday to buy 14,000 tonnes of 45 ICUMSA white sugar for shipment in November/December.
